_about: Location fields and requirement sentences from public job feeds (Remote OK, Himalayas, Jobicy, Working Nomads, Remotive, Greenhouse boards), 21 Oct 2026, plus a few Pakistan-specific cases the feeds lacked (marked by mentioning Pakistan, a Pakistani city or UTC+5). Only short fragments, never whole postings. Labelled for 'can someone in Pakistan take this?' by Claude, for the owner to review. eligible/likely = yes; unclear = needs a closer look; not-eligible = no.
